// One actual headless DAILY miner, in the parent-owned outer process group.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"time"
)

type cliStatus struct {
	Version      uint32 `json:"version"`
	ObservedAtMS int64  `json:"observed_at_ms"`
	ConfigID     string `json:"config_id"`
	State        string `json:"state"`
	WorkerState  string `json:"worker_state"`
	Code         string `json:"code"`
	Records      uint64 `json:"records"`
	Pending      uint64 `json:"pending"`
}
type cliOwner struct {
	parentPID, pgid                                                         int
	cmd                                                                     *exec.Cmd
	done                                                                    chan error
	stdoutDone, stderrDone                                                  chan struct{}
	stdoutRead, stdoutWrite, stderrRead, stderrWrite                        *os.File
	stdoutLog, stderrLog                                                    *os.File
	started, joined, closed, unexpected, forced, stdoutJoined, stderrJoined bool
	stopAttempted                                                           bool
	signalCount                                                             int
	waitErr, stopErr                                                        error
	mu                                                                      sync.Mutex
	ioErr                                                                   error
	statuses                                                                []cliStatus
	configID                                                                string
}

func (c *cliOwner) ioFailure(e error) {
	if e == nil {
		return
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	if c.ioErr == nil {
		c.ioErr = e
	}
	c.mu.Unlock()
}
func (c *cliOwner) readOutput(file, log *os.File, stdout bool, done chan struct{}) {
	defer close(done)
	defer func() { c.ioFailure(errors.Join(file.Close(), log.Sync(), log.Close())) }()
	reader := bufio.NewReaderSize(file, 4096)
	total := 0
	for {
		raw, e := reader.ReadSlice('\n')
		if len(raw) > 0 {
			if total+len(raw) > 1<<20 {
				c.ioFailure(errors.New("CLI output cap"))
			}
			if total < 1<<20 {
				piece := raw[:min(len(raw), (1<<20)-total)]
				n, x := log.Write(piece)
				c.ioFailure(x)
				if n != len(piece) {
					c.ioFailure(io.ErrShortWrite)
				}
			}
			total = min((1<<20)+1, total+len(raw))
			if !stdout {
				c.ioFailure(errors.New("unexpected CLI diagnostic output"))
			} else if total <= 1<<20 {
				if e != nil || len(raw) >= 4096 || raw[len(raw)-1] != '\n' || bytes.ContainsRune(raw, '\r') {
					c.ioFailure(errors.New("CLI frame shape"))
				} else {
					body := raw[:len(raw)-1]
					var v cliStatus
					d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
					d.DisallowUnknownFields()
					x := d.Decode(&v)
					canonical, ce := json.Marshal(v)
					if x != nil || ce != nil || !bytes.Equal(body, canonical) || v.Version != 2 || v.ConfigID != c.configID || v.State != "signed_in" || v.ObservedAtMS <= 0 || v.Records > 64 || v.Pending > v.Records {
						c.ioFailure(errors.New("CLI status correlation"))
					} else {
						valid := false
						switch v.WorkerState {
						case "ready", "stopped", "failed", "paused", "preparing", "retrying", "hashing", "delivering", "unavailable":
							valid = true
						}
						if !valid {
							c.ioFailure(errors.New("CLI worker state"))
						}
						switch v.Code {
						case "", "unavailable", "outcome_unknown", "busy", "capacity", "rate_limited":
						default:
							c.ioFailure(errors.New("CLI worker refusal"))
						}
						c.mu.Lock()
						if len(c.statuses) >= 1024 {
							if c.ioErr == nil {
								c.ioErr = errors.New("CLI status count")
							}
						} else {
							if len(c.statuses) > 0 && v.Records < c.statuses[len(c.statuses)-1].Records {
								if c.ioErr == nil {
									c.ioErr = errors.New("CLI record regression")
								}
							}
							c.statuses = append(c.statuses, v)
						}
						c.mu.Unlock()
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if errors.Is(e, io.EOF) {
			return
		}
		if e != nil && !errors.Is(e, bufio.ErrBufferFull) {
			c.ioFailure(errors.New("CLI output read"))
			return
		}
	}
}
func launchCLI(binary, root, private, configID, generation string, owner **cliOwner) {
	c := &cliOwner{configID: configID, statuses: []cliStatus{}, done: make(chan error, 1), stdoutDone: make(chan struct{}), stderrDone: make(chan struct{})}
	*owner = c
	var e error
	c.stdoutRead, c.stdoutWrite, e = os.Pipe()
	check(e, "CLI stdout pipe")
	c.stderrRead, c.stderrWrite, e = os.Pipe()
	check(e, "CLI stderr pipe")
	c.stdoutLog, e = os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(root, generation+"-stdout.jsonl"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	check(e, "CLI stdout log")
	c.stderrLog, e = os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(root, generation+"-stderr.log"), os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	check(e, "CLI stderr log")
	args := []string{"--daily-recoverable-issue", "--candidate-remote-pool", "--candidate-name-version=1", "--data-dir", filepath.Join(root, "owned-gym"), "--remote-attachment-root", filepath.Join(root, "remote-attachment"), "--remote-config", filepath.Join(private, "remote-config.json"), "--remote-node-rpc", filepath.Join(private, "remote-rpc.json"), "--remote-pool-credential", filepath.Join(private, "pool.credential"), "--remote-admission-credential", filepath.Join(private, "admission.credential")}
	c.cmd = exec.Command(binary, args...)
	c.cmd.Stdout, c.cmd.Stderr = c.stdoutWrite, c.stderrWrite
	// No process group/session override: the exact child inherits the outer owner.
	check(c.cmd.Start(), "actual CLI start")
	c.started = true
	c.parentPID = os.Getpid()
	c.pgid, e = syscall.Getpgid(c.cmd.Process.Pid)
	parentGroup, pe := syscall.Getpgid(0)
	groupErr := errors.Join(e, pe)
	go c.readOutput(c.stdoutRead, c.stdoutLog, true, c.stdoutDone)
	go c.readOutput(c.stderrRead, c.stderrLog, false, c.stderrDone)
	go func() { c.done <- c.cmd.Wait() }()
	var writerErr error
	for _, p := range []**os.File{&c.stdoutWrite, &c.stderrWrite} {
		e := (*p).Close()
		c.ioFailure(e)
		if e == nil {
			*p = nil
		}
		writerErr = errors.Join(writerErr, e)
	}
	check(errors.Join(groupErr, writerErr), "original CLI group/writer ownership")
	require(c.pgid == parentGroup && c.pgid == c.parentPID, "CLI inherits original outer process group")
}
func (c *cliOwner) observe() {
	if c == nil || !c.started || c.joined {
		return
	}
	select {
	case e := <-c.done:
		c.joined = true
		c.waitErr = e
		c.unexpected = true
	default:
	}
}
func (c *cliOwner) status() (cliStatus, bool) {
	c.observe()
	require(c != nil && c.started && !c.joined, "actual CLI remains original and running")
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	check(c.ioErr, "CLI public output")
	if len(c.statuses) == 0 {
		return cliStatus{}, false
	}
	return c.statuses[len(c.statuses)-1], true
}
func (c *cliOwner) stop() error {
	if c == nil {
		return nil
	}
	if c.stopAttempted {
		return c.stopErr
	}
	c.stopAttempted = true
	if !c.started {
		var e error
		for _, f := range []*os.File{c.stdoutRead, c.stdoutWrite, c.stderrRead, c.stderrWrite, c.stdoutLog, c.stderrLog} {
			if f != nil {
				e = errors.Join(e, f.Close())
			}
		}
		c.closed = true
		c.stopErr = e
		return e
	}
	c.observe()
	var e error
	if !c.joined {
		e = c.cmd.Process.Signal(syscall.SIGTERM)
		if e == nil {
			c.signalCount++
		}
		select {
		case x := <-c.done:
			c.joined = true
			c.waitErr = x
		case <-time.After(30 * time.Second):
			c.forced = true
			e = errors.Join(e, errors.New("CLI stop bound"), c.cmd.Process.Kill())
			select {
			case x := <-c.done:
				c.joined = true
				c.waitErr = x
			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
				e = errors.Join(e, errors.New("CLI did not join"))
			}
		}
	}
	// The two reader goroutines own their read ends/logs and close them once.
	for _, v := range []struct {
		done   chan struct{}
		file   *os.File
		joined *bool
	}{{c.stdoutDone, c.stdoutRead, &c.stdoutJoined}, {c.stderrDone, c.stderrRead, &c.stderrJoined}} {
		select {
		case <-v.done:
			*v.joined = true
		case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
			e = errors.Join(e, errors.New("CLI output join bound"), v.file.Close())
			select {
			case <-v.done:
				*v.joined = true
			case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
				e = errors.Join(e, errors.New("CLI output did not join"))
			}
		}
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	ie := c.ioErr
	c.mu.Unlock()
	e = errors.Join(e, c.waitErr, ie)
	if c.unexpected || c.forced || !c.joined || !c.stdoutJoined || !c.stderrJoined || c.signalCount != 1 {
		e = errors.Join(e, errors.New("CLI lifetime incomplete"))
	}
	c.closed = c.joined && c.stdoutJoined && c.stderrJoined
	c.stopErr = e
	return e
}
func (c *cliOwner) evidence() map[string]any {
	if c == nil {
		return nil
	}
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	var last cliStatus
	if len(c.statuses) > 0 {
		last = c.statuses[len(c.statuses)-1]
	}
	pid := 0
	exit := -1
	if c.started {
		pid = c.cmd.Process.Pid
	}
	if c.joined && c.cmd.ProcessState != nil {
		exit = c.cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()
	}
	return map[string]any{"pid": pid, "parent_pid": c.parentPID, "pgid": c.pgid, "joined": c.joined, "exit_code": exit, "signal": "SIGTERM", "signal_count": c.signalCount, "forced_kill": c.forced, "unexpected_exit": c.unexpected, "wait_error": c.waitErr != nil, "stdout_joined": c.stdoutJoined, "stderr_joined": c.stderrJoined, "io_error": c.ioErr != nil, "status_count": len(c.statuses), "config_id": c.configID, "last_status": last}
}
